capabilities: Render Markdown content in block link suggestion popups
Trigger when typing block references like [[note title^ or [[^
Install via BRAT for beta releases
disambiguation: Only affects block link suggestions triggered with ^, not regular note-to-note link suggestions.
extras: README contains before/after comparison screenshots; installation is documented for both the community plugin browser and BRAT; the author solicits donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
intentEvidence: enhances the built-in block link suggestion (the auto-completion triggered when typing [[note title^ or [[^)
problem: Obsidian's built-in block link suggestions show blocks as plain text, making it hard to identify the content of a block before linking it.

relations.evidence: You can also install the latest beta release using BRAT

summary: Block link suggestion enhancer that renders Markdown previews of block references inside Obsidian's built-in [[note^ autocomplete popup.
